scripts.db:push: bunx wrangler --config ../api/wrangler.toml d1 migrations apply cire-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:local: bunx wrangler --config ../api/wrangler.toml d1 migrations apply cire-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:dev: bunx wrangler --config ../api/wrangler.toml d1 migrations apply cire-db-dev --env dev --remote
scripts.db:migrate:prod: bunx wrangler --config ../api/wrangler.toml d1 migrations apply cire-db --env production --remote
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf ../api/.wrangler/state/v3/d1 && bun run db:push && bun run db:seed
